about: the interface's view model of a playable character's player-side state (hotbars, turn, selection)

evidence.says: the Toolkit's accessor names +0x760 IsSelectedCharacter; in dx11 the byte at +0x760 read 1 in a drawn start and 0 in a game drawn from no frame, and the reaction prompt interface update (bg3_dx11.exe@25605617+0x16D06D0) adds an interruptor's player id to the prompted players only when it is set; written 1, the prompt window opened
